title: Current Jacobian portfolio status and evaluation gates for Frontier v1

move_ledger.source: Formal Conjectures issue 4601 and pull request 4602
move_ledger.mathematical_move: Compute distances relative to one designated vertex set while keeping maximum internal set distance distinct from set eccentricity.
move_ledger.required_input: One exact labelled finite graph and one nonempty designated vertex subset.
move_ledger.output_artifact: A bound distance profile with per-vertex distances and both named set aggregates.
move_ledger.trust_boundary: Graph-library computation is producer evidence; an independent breadth-first replay is required for VERIFIED assurance.
move_ledger.recurrence_signal: The maintained formalization uses both invariants in several conjectures and the substitution caused a concrete semantic falsehood.

move_ledger.source: Formal Conjectures issue 4600 and pinned Optio artifact
move_ledger.mathematical_move: Classify powerful integers, scan adjacent candidates, and cover a bounded interval by many kernel-checked chunks.
move_ledger.required_input: Positive integers for the predicate; a pinned chunk manifest, certificates, interval scope, and Lean environment for range replay.
move_ledger.output_artifact: A one-integer powerfulness decision, or separately a bounded no-three-consecutive replay record.
move_ledger.trust_boundary: One-number factorization replay and source-specific Lean chunk coverage are distinct checker boundaries; neither proves the unbounded conjecture.
move_ledger.recurrence_signal: The atomic predicate recurs throughout the source workflow, while the 3,524-chunk format currently has only one maintained deployment episode.

move_ledger.mathematical_move: Evaluate one finite coverage function on every subset and replay a rational quadratic dual domination certificate under pairwise marginals.
move_ledger.required_input: Finite coverage sets, exact rational marginals, and exact linear and pair coefficients.
move_ledger.output_artifact: An exhaustive subset-indexed dual replay with exact objective and domain-semantic binding.
move_ledger.trust_boundary: Generic LP optimization may propose coefficients; an independent exact enumerator must verify all subset inequalities and their coverage semantics.
move_ledger.recurrence_signal: The generic LP portfolio repeatedly leaves the same domain-binding gap across primal marginals, pair moments, and coverage values.

move_ledger.source: Frontier challenge and local model-run feedback review
move_ledger.mathematical_move: Requests mixed Gaussian arithmetic, formal power series, and several lattice operations without converging on one shared typed outcome.
move_ledger.required_input: Workflow-specific mathematical objects that are not yet normalized across episodes.
move_ledger.trust_boundary: Provider and checker boundaries differ across the observed requests.
move_ledger.recurrence_signal: Insufficient recurring workflows for one atomic contract in each area.

cases.current_boundary: Finite binomial computation and cleared polynomial identities are covered, but no domain-owned symbolic central-binomial ratio or hypergeometric identity binds the universal reduction.
cases.next_action: Use the no-retrieval runner to measure whether agents keep finite checks separate from the all-parameter proof; do not add a contract until recurrent symbolic workflows are observed.

cases.current_boundary: The exact arrangement flats and first graded Jacobian syzygy are now domain-owned and independently replayable within their declared degree and input bounds.
cases.next_action: Run repeated public model reproductions under the frozen no-retrieval profile; the v1 MISSING label remains historical and must not be edited.

cases.current_boundary: Finite Sidon checks are possible, but no perfect-difference-set semantics, universal obstruction artifact, or pinned source formal environment is installed.
cases.next_action: Return to workflow discovery before proposing a broad perfect-difference-set contract.

cases.current_boundary: Individual powerfulness can be derived from exact factorization, but there is no typed powerful-number decision artifact and no installed replay for the source's 3,524 bounded Lean chunks.
cases.next_action: Implement and independently check the atomic powerful-number predicate first; keep the 10^14 chunk replay as a separate provider- and format-bound candidate.

cases.current_boundary: Exact generic LP and finite coverage operations exist, but no checker binds a quadratic dual certificate to coverage-function values, marginals, and all pairwise-independence subset constraints.
cases.next_action: Implement the finite coverage-semantic dual checker, then compare it with generic LP-only traces on generated held-out instances.

cases.current_boundary: The extremal graph quantities are available, but distances relative to one designated vertex subset remain absent; whole-graph diameter, radius, and eccentricity are not substitutes.
cases.next_action: Implement and independently replay one restricted-set distance profile before evaluating semantic-confusion reduction.

capability_candidates.summary: Add one graph-domain outcome that computes all distances needed to distinguish internal designated-set diameter from set eccentricity.
evidence: Formal Conjectures issue 4601 documents the invariant substitution bug and an explicit six-vertex counterexample.
Formal Conjectures PR 4602 adds a dedicated distMaxSet definition rather than reusing eccSet.
Current capability discovery exposes whole-graph properties but no designated-set distance outcome.
open_gaps: Typed disconnected-distance semantics and bounded input contract.
Generated held-out graph oracle and treatment portfolio.
capability_candidates.next_action: Hand the accepted contract to implement-math-capability, then implement its independent checker before comparative evaluation.
capability_candidates.atomic_outcome: For one exact labelled graph and one nonempty designated vertex set, return vertex-to-set distances, internal set-distance maximum, and set eccentricity with explicit disconnectedness semantics.
capability_candidates.recurrence_basis: The same distinction appears in the Conjecture 18 semantic bug and in maintained graph formalizations using both set eccentricity and maximum internal distance; current catalog search returns only whole-graph invariant operations.
capability_candidates.provider_boundary: A thin maintained-graph-library producer may compute distances, but labels, designated-set identity, unreachable vertices, and scope belong to the domain contract.
capability_candidates.verification_boundary: An operator-authorized checker should replay breadth-first distances independently of the producer and bind every returned aggregate to the exact graph and designated set.
capability_candidates.public_reproduction: jcb-postdoc-018 plus generated labelled connected and disconnected graphs with singleton and multi-vertex designated sets.
capability_candidates.evaluation_hypothesis: The domain-owned restricted-set result reduces invariant substitution errors without increasing false VERIFIED claims relative to whole-graph-only access.

capability_candidates.summary: Publish one exact powerful-number decision with a factorization-bound witness, separate from every range-enumeration claim.
evidence: The bounded Optio workflow repeatedly applies the same exact powerful-number predicate before chunk coverage.
Current capability discovery finds exact prime factorization but no powerful-number semantic outcome.
open_gaps: Explicit convention and validation for n=1 and positivity.
Independent factorization and exponent replay binding.
capability_candidates.next_action: Implement the atomic predicate and its checker before designing any batch or range-certificate capability.
capability_candidates.atomic_outcome: Decide whether one supplied positive integer is powerful and expose an exact prime-factorization witness for the decision.
capability_candidates.recurrence_basis: This is a fundamental number-theory predicate needed by both direct classifications and any future bounded powerful-number certificate format; current exact factorization does not publish the domain conclusion.
capability_candidates.provider_boundary: The producer may reuse maintained exact integer factorization, while powerfulness semantics and witness normalization remain domain-owned.
capability_candidates.verification_boundary: Independent replay checks factor multiplication, primality evidence already authorized by the factorization contract, and the exponent-at-least-two predicate; it makes no range-coverage claim.
capability_candidates.public_reproduction: Small positive integers spanning powerful and non-powerful cases, including 1 under an explicit convention, plus adversarial forged exponent witnesses.
capability_candidates.evaluation_hypothesis: The typed predicate reduces agent-authored semantic bridges and preserves the distinction between one-number decisions and bounded or unbounded nonexistence claims.

capability_candidates.summary: Keep bounded chunk replay as a distinct source-format capability, but do not implement it until the certificate and provider contract are reproducible.
evidence: The source reports 3,524 Lean chunks through 10^14 rather than one small portable certificate.
The source workflow is pinned to an external Lean/mathlib environment and substantial compute resources.
One public workflow is insufficient to generalize the format beyond its maintained artifact.
open_gaps: Stable chunk manifest and certificate schema.
Pinned optional provider installation and resource envelope.
Exact coverage binding across every interval chunk.
Second independent workflow or explicit source-specific scope decision.
capability_candidates.next_action: Return to discovery with the pinned Optio artifact and reproduce a small chunk before accepting a contract.
capability_candidates.atomic_outcome: Replay one externally produced bounded certificate that no three consecutive powerful numbers occur over its exact declared integer interval.
capability_candidates.recurrence_basis: The public Optio artifact contains 3,524 Lean chunks through 10^14, but only one maintained certificate family and deployment episode is currently established.
capability_candidates.provider_boundary: The 10^14 reproduction is tied to a pinned external Lean/mathlib environment and source-specific chunk format with substantial memory and CPU requirements.
capability_candidates.verification_boundary: Verification must bind chunk coverage, interval boundaries, the exact powerful predicate, certificate format, checker identity, and every checked chunk; successful finite replay cannot promote the unbounded conjecture.
capability_candidates.public_reproduction: Start with the source's smaller bounded chunks only after the certificate schema and pinned provider can be installed reproducibly.
capability_candidates.evaluation_hypothesis: A typed replay capability would turn source-specific bounded formal evidence into inspectable Jacobian evidence without increasing the claimed scope beyond the checked interval.

capability_candidates.summary: Verify one finite coverage-semantic quadratic dual certificate exhaustively, while leaving generic rational LP optimization separate.
evidence: The five-element source has an exact 32-subset oracle and rational objective 479/160.
Current rational LP computation does not bind coverage values or pairwise moments to the domain claim.
Finite exhaustive replay supplies an independent oracle suitable for false-certification attacks.
open_gaps: Generated held-out instances and forged-coefficient corpus.
capability_candidates.next_action: Hand the accepted verification outcome directly to implement-math-capability-checker, then freeze the held-out generator before model runs.
capability_candidates.atomic_outcome: For one bounded finite coverage instance, rational marginals, and one quadratic dual candidate, exhaust all subsets and verify exact domination and objective semantics.
capability_candidates.recurrence_basis: The public five-element counterexample exposes a semantic gap not owned by the generic rational LP producer: coverage values and pairwise subset moments must be bound to the same exact finite instance.
capability_candidates.provider_boundary: Exact rational enumeration can use standard-library fractions; the coverage and pairwise-independence interpretation belongs to this domain checker rather than a generic LP adapter.
capability_candidates.verification_boundary: The checker must be operator-authorized, independent of any optimizing producer, exhaustive over the declared bounded ground set, and unable to certify incomplete subset coverage.
capability_candidates.public_reproduction: jcb-postdoc-017 plus generated small coverage instances with independently enumerated hidden oracle values and forged dual coefficients.
capability_candidates.evaluation_hypothesis: The semantic checker increases exact certificate completion and lowers unsupported domain-level claims compared with generic LP access alone.
